maps.description: The Ohre loops around Loket's rock: a baroque square, a castle and a stepped lower street. Across the river lie a green village, spa villas, a porcelain works, a collective farm and cottages hidden in the spruce woods. Cross the bridges, search house by house, and keep a route out of the valley.
maps.name: LOKET / RIVERBEND

maps.description: An army training area behind a concrete gate. Every weapon, magazine and attachment lies in the armory, every garment in the quartermaster store, rations in the mess tent, medicine and tools in the field stores; take anything, it is back on the table a few seconds later. Zero rifles on the 300 m range, clear the shoot house, run the obstacle course, or try your aim on the infected penned east of the range.
maps.name: TRAINING GROUND
